name: autoesperto
description: AutoEsperto — il consulente italiano per comprare auto usate con consapevolezza

scripts.dev: node scripts/workspace-run.mjs apps/web npm run dev
scripts.dev:api: node scripts/workspace-run.mjs apps/api npm run dev
scripts.build: node scripts/workspace-run.mjs packages/database npm run build && node scripts/workspace-run.mjs apps/web npm run build && node scripts/workspace-run.mjs apps/api npm run build
scripts.lint: node scripts/workspace-run.mjs packages/database npm run lint && node scripts/workspace-run.mjs packages/types npm run lint && node scripts/workspace-run.mjs packages/ui npm run lint && node scripts/workspace-run.mjs apps/api npm run lint && node scripts/workspace-run.mjs apps/web npm run lint
scripts.db:generate: node scripts/workspace-run.mjs packages/database npm run db:generate
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/workspace-run.mjs packages/database npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:studio: node scripts/workspace-run.mjs packages/database npm run db:studio
